title: clove item list envelope
description: A list response. Each element carries at least the lean list fields (id, status, type, priority, title); the file-scan path additionally includes the full frontmatter, the index path does not.

listMeta.title: list `_meta`
listMeta.description: What the server applied to produce `data`: the window, the ordering, the filter set, and the tier that answered. Every key is optional because one schema covers each list producer — `ls`/`ready`/`blocked`/`query` emit the window, ordering, filters and source; `search` emits everything but `filters` (it has no field filters); `export json` emits `source` + `clove_export` and no window at all. `additionalProperties` is false so a new `_meta` key has to be described here rather than shipping invisible to a client generated from this schema.

total.description: Matches BEFORE the window — always the full count, never the page size.

returned.description: Elements in `data` (`total` capped by the window).

offset.description: Rows skipped from the start of the ordered result.

limit.description: The page size in force, in the same encoding callers pass in: 0 means UNLIMITED, not "empty page". Echoed so a client can read the effective cap instead of memorizing each surface's default (CLI 100, MCP 50, web unlimited).

sort.description: The ordering field in force. `relevance` is search-only (it is not a sortable field, so it cannot be requested on a list command).

source.description: Which read tier answered. `files` on a producer that has no tiering (`search`, `export`).

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems encountered while producing this result.

clove_export.description: `export json` only: the container version, so a later `import json` can version-check the file.

filters.title: the applied filter set
filters.description: The parsed, canonicalized filters — echoed for the same reason `limit` is: a multi-valued filter has several accepted spellings (`--label a --label b`, MCP `["a","b"]`, web `?label=a,b`) and every value is normalized, so a client should be able to read back what was applied. Any-of within a field, all-of across fields; `labels` is all-of within the field too. An empty array does not constrain.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring over id/title/labels (NOT bodies — that is `clove search`).
